trigger: internal sequential counter trojan_cnt reaches 8'hD7 (215 decimal) while en=1; this occurs after exactly 215 rising clock edges with en=1 asserted since the last reset
observable_effect: on the clock edge where trojan_cnt == 8'hD7 and en=1, count is forced to 8'h00 (reset to zero) instead of incrementing normally — a denial-of-service that zeroes the counter output; the clean module would instead increment count normally on that same edge
